title: SDLC Review Policy v1
description: The versioned policy contract that selects and governs reviews of SDLC task results. It declares applicability, gate mode, required criteria and evidence, authorization, agent-profile and prompt references, execution limits, output constraints, escalation, and explicit host effects. It does not contain a review finding or decide whether a particular result is correct.
$comment: This policy configures review execution and host enforcement; it does not replace the reviewing agent or embed sdlc-agent-profile/v1. The host must resolve the effective policy deterministically, verify policy inheritance and locked overrides, resolve agentProfileRef and promptTemplateRef, translate the permitted agent configuration into llm-request/v1, render and digest the request, validate https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/task-review/v1 output, independently check target and evidence digests, enforce authorization and conflict rules, and apply lifecycle effects only through an explicit host action. A policy decision never silently mutates task or work-item lifecycle state. Evidence-tier fields use the canonical vocabulary from https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/evidence-tier/v1; the enum is repeated locally so nested examples remain synchronously authorable.

policyId.description: Stable lower-kebab-case identity of this review policy within its authority domain.

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of this policy instance; changes to its effective rules require a new digest and may require a new version.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the review policy's purpose and governance boundary.
examples: Require an authorized code review before an implementation result may satisfy its implementation-result gate.

authority.description: The source and precedence metadata that establish who controls this policy and how it participates in inheritance.

scope.description: The task and gate selectors to which this policy applies.

mode.description: Whether this policy disables review, makes review available without blocking by default, or requires an accepted gate before the governed transition.

items.description: One named approval or review checkpoint governed by this policy.

gates.description: Named gates whose review decisions can be evaluated under this policy.

review.description: Rules for the review subject, required criteria, findings, and decisions.

authorization.description: Actor authorization, independence, and approval-count rules applied by the host.

evidence.description: Evidence presence, freshness, and evidence-tier rules that must hold before an accepted decision can satisfy the gate.

execution.description: References and bounded settings used to construct the review-agent request; the referenced agent profile will later translate into llm-request/v1.

output.description: The structured output and reproducibility records required from the review execution.

escalation.description: Rules for abstention, blocked execution, conflicts, and exhausted review/rework cycles.

transitions.description: Explicit host actions and eligibility effects for each terminal review disposition; these are not direct lifecycle mutations by the agent.

AuthoritySource.description: The configuration layer from which the effective policy was selected.

Authority.description: Policy provenance, ownership, and inheritance precedence metadata.

source.description: The layer that supplied this policy.

ref.description: Durable reference to the policy source or authority record.

owner.description: Stable owner identity responsible for maintaining or authorizing the policy.

locked.description: Whether lower-precedence policy sources are prevented from weakening or disabling this policy.

Scope.description: Selectors identifying the tasks, review modes, and gates governed by the policy.

items.description: A task kind to which this policy applies.

taskTypes.description: Task kinds whose results may be selected by this policy.

items.description: A review mode to which this policy applies.

reviewKinds.description: Review modes governed by this policy.

items.description: A named review or approval gate selected by this policy.

gateIds.description: Gate identifiers for which this policy is effective.

items.description: An optional eight-digit task-tree range selector.

orderKeyRanges.description: Optional task-tree regions that further restrict policy applicability.

OrderKeyRange.description: An inclusive fixed-width eight-digit task-tree range used for deterministic policy selection.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound of the order-key range.

end.description: Inclusive upper bound of the order-key range; host validation must ensure it is not lower than start.

Gate.description: One named checkpoint whose accepted review decision can satisfy a governed transition.

purpose.description: The transition or assurance boundary checked by this gate.

required.description: Whether this gate must be accepted before its governed transition may become eligible.

minimumApprovals.description: Number of acceptable decisions required for this gate, subject to authorization and distinct-actor rules.

CriterionRule.description: A policy-required review criterion and the minimum evidence tier permitted to support it.

id.description: Stable policy criterion identifier referenced by review intent and criteria selection.

statement.description: The condition that must be evaluated for this criterion.
examples: The result stays within the declared implementation scope and non-goals.

required.description: Whether this criterion must be satisfied for an accepted decision under this policy.

minimumEvidenceTier.description: The minimum source evidence tier that may support a satisfied evaluation.

examples.statement: The result stays within the declared implementation scope and non-goals.

EvidenceTier.description: The shared SDLC evidence tier vocabulary defined by https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/evidence-tier/v1.

ReviewRules.description: Required structure and semantic completeness rules for the review payload.

taskSchema.description: The task-specific review contract expected for the review child result.

items.description: A review mode allowed by this policy.

allowedKinds.description: Review modes for which the policy's criteria and execution rules are valid.

items.description: One criterion required or recommended by the policy.

examples.statement: The result satisfies the required behavior.

requiredCriteria.description: The criteria that must be present in the review intent and evaluated in the review result.

examples.statement: The result satisfies the required behavior.

items.description: Finding severities that prevent acceptance while their findings remain open.

requireCompleteCriteriaCoverage.description: Whether the result must contain an evaluation for every criterion selected in intent before a decision can be accepted.

Authorization.description: Host-enforced authorization and independence constraints for review decisions.

requiredRole.description: Role that an actor must hold to provide an acceptable decision.

minimumApprovals.description: Minimum number of authorized acceptable decisions required for the selected gate.

allowSelfApproval.description: Whether the producer of the target result may also produce an acceptable review decision.

requireDistinctActors.description: Whether approvals must come from distinct actor identities rather than repeated decisions by one actor.

conflictAction.description: The required handling when the host detects a conflict of interest or failed independence check.

EvidenceRules.description: Host-checkable rules for the evidence required to support a review decision.

items.description: An evidence kind that must be represented before acceptance can satisfy the gate.

requiredKinds.description: Evidence categories required by this policy.

minimumTier.description: Minimum evidence tier required for the policy's required evidence set.

requireCurrentTargetDigest.description: Whether the target result digest must still match when the host evaluates the review decision.

requireCurrentEvidenceDigests.description: Whether referenced evidence digests must still match the records available at decision time.

allowAgentOnlyEvidence.description: Whether an evidence claim produced only by the reviewing agent may satisfy a required evidence rule without an independently resolvable source.

ModelConstraint.description: Optional allowlist constraint for the provider and model selected by the later agent-profile to llm-request translation.

provider.description: Required provider identity or approved provider family.

model.description: Required model identity or approved model family.

ReadBoundary.description: The evidence and repository-resource boundary exposed to the review agent.

items.description: A resource kind the agent may inspect for this review.

allowedKinds.description: Kinds of resources that may be supplied to or read by the agent.

items.description: A resource kind the agent must not receive or inspect.

deniedKinds.description: Kinds of sensitive or out-of-scope resources denied to the agent.

ExecutionRules.description: Bounded review-agent invocation settings and references; agent-profile/v1 itself is intentionally defined outside this contract.

agentProfileRef.description: Reference to the agent profile that will be translated into llm-request/v1; the profile is not embedded here.

promptTemplateRef.description: Reference to the versioned prompt template or prompt-construction instructions used with this policy.

outputSchema.description: The structured output contract expected from the review agent.

oneOf.description: An explicit provider and model allowlist constraint.

modelConstraint.description: The provider/model restriction applied after resolving the agent profile.

thinking.description: Reasoning effort requested from the later llm-request/v1 translation, subject to provider support.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature requested for the review invocation; deterministic policies normally use zero.

maxFailedAttempts.description: Maximum provider or invocation failures the host may retry before recording execution failure.

maxIterations.description: Maximum successful request/response iterations permitted for one review action, including bounded correction requests.

readBoundary.description: The resource boundary the host must enforce for the review agent.

OutputRules.description: Output-shape and provenance requirements for accepting a review result as a policy-compliant decision.

schema.description: Structured review result schema required by the host.

items.description: A review result field that must be present and semantically evaluated.

requiredFields.description: Fields that the host must require in the structured review result.

requireReproducibility.description: Whether policy-compliant review results must record policy, prompt, agent-configuration, and execution-receipt digests.

requireExecutionReceipt.description: Whether the host must retain a durable bounded execution receipt for the review invocation.

allowDecisionWithoutAgent.description: Whether an authorized non-agent actor may submit a decision without an agent execution; false preserves agent-driven review for this policy.

EscalationRules.description: Bounded handling for review uncertainty, execution blockers, conflicts, and repeated corrective cycles.

allowAbstention.description: Whether the reviewing agent may return abstained instead of an approval disposition.

onAbstention.description: Host action when an allowed abstention is recorded.

onBlocked.description: Host action when required review inputs or execution are blocked.

onConflict.description: Host action when a policy or actor conflict prevents a valid decision.

maxReviewReworkCycles.description: Maximum number of review/rework cycles allowed before the policy's exhausted action applies.

onExhausted.description: Host action when the review/rework limit is exhausted without an accepted gate.

escalationRole.description: Role responsible for resolving an escalated review condition.

Transition.description: The explicit host-level effect associated with one review disposition; it does not authorize silent lifecycle mutation.

satisfyGate.description: Whether a policy-compliant disposition may satisfy the selected gate after host validation.

createRework.description: Whether the host may create a distinct rework action for this disposition.

downstreamEligible.description: Whether the governed downstream transition may become eligible after the explicit host action.

requiresExplicitHostAction.description: Whether a separate authorized host operation is required before recording the gate or eligibility effect.

TransitionRules.description: Explicit host effects for each review disposition supported by the policy.

accepted.description: Effect after an accepted decision passes host policy checks.

changesRequested.description: Effect after a valid changes_requested decision.

rejected.description: Effect after a valid rejected decision.

blocked.description: Effect when review cannot safely produce or apply a decision.

examples.description: Require an authorized code review before an implementation result may satisfy its implementation-result gate.
